title: Abid ghareeb beykas-o-naachaar margaya
body:
Abid ghareeb beykas-o-naachaar margaya
Saadaath khaak uddaayein kay Sardaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Saayaa rahaa saroun pa na chawthay Imam ka
Zehra ki jaan Hussain ka dildaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaanton pa kheinchtey thay jisey raahey Shaam mein
Woh saarbaan-e-Ithrath-e-Athaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Shammey mazaarey Panjetan-e-Paak bhujj gayee
Saidaaniyoun ka haaye parasthaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Baanu ka chaand zeir-e-zameen haaye chhupp gaya
Faaqaa kasho Ghareeb Dilafgaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Beti Hasan ki hogayi beywaa hazaar haif
Haider ka pothaa aashiq-e-Ghaffaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Rothaa rahaa jo baap ko chaalees saal takh
Woh aaj Shaahey deen ka Azadaar margaya
Bin baap kay layeen ney Baqar ko kardiyaa
Chauthaa Wasee-e-Ahmad-e-Mukhtaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyunkar Shaoor khaak uddaaoon na aaj mai
Mai jiski nasl sey hoon woh sardaar margaya
